candidate.scope: The middle, Div-Seq-labeled row of the assigned Illumina poster crop: in vivo EdU labeling, nuclei isolation, fluorescent Click-IT tagging, FACS selection, nuclear polyadenylated RNA access, cDNA synthesis, PCR, tagmentation, and gap repair/PCR to an indexed P5/P7 library fragment. The top Nuc-Seq row, bottom SCRB-Seq row and clipped N6-methyladenosine structure at far right are adjacent context, not alternative targets or connected branches of this card. The left single-cell/poly(A) icon and repeated SCRB-Seq caption are inventoried as descriptive/mislabeled content, not a material input feeding the tissue route. Div-Seq uses an sNuc-Seq component; modified Smart-Seq2 is an embedded library-preparation component identified by the primary paper, not another target. This is the depicted architecture, not a complete execution protocol.
